title: Board View has the same Density setting as Tech View
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 led by Esther Howard):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Open the Density control in the toolbar and write down its options and which is selected.
  4. Choose Compact.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  6. Open the Density control.
  7. Choose Comfortable.
  8. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  9. Open the Density control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Board View has a Density control offering Compact, Regular and Comfortable.
  • After choosing Compact in Board View, Tech View's Density control shows Compact selected.
  • After choosing Comfortable in Tech View, Board View shows Comfortable selected: one setting shared by both displays.
  • The design offers "Card size: Compact / Detailed" on Board View and "Row height: Small / Medium / Large" on Tech View: those options are a fail against the specification, write down what you see.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R11, S6-R1, S6-R3, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions 853901313 SQ-4. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), Board "Card size" and By Lead Tech "Row height" menus; on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R11: “Provide the shared Density control from Story 6 in Board View.”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View and Board View.”
  • S6-R3: “Share one density selection between Tech View and Board View.”
